reader.requirement: At --std 85 (Amendment 1's Intrinsic Function module) FUNCTION TAN takes exactly one parenthesised argument-1 of class numeric (an identifier, numeric literal or arithmetic expression), and as a numeric function it may stand only inside an arithmetic expression. Any other argument count, a non-numeric argument, an ALL subscript or missing parentheses must be refused.

ConstructRegistry numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: below 2002 a numeric/integer function written where an identifier stands (MOVE, DISPLAY) is refused COBOL0900; a function inside an arithmetic expression is not screened

the OPTIONS paragraph (so ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-*) is refused below 2002, so NumericRenderer#StandardDecimal is false at 85 and the renderer takes its native arm, the same arm 2023 takes with no OPTIONS paragraph

reader.edition-search: grep IsDefinedAt/IntroducedIn/RemovedIn/DialectLevel/ConstructRegistry over IntrinsicBinder.cs, IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs and IntrinsicRenderer.cs; the arity and argument-class screens consult no edition

reader.notes: The catalog's Fixed 1..1 arity (COBOL1504) and the argument-class table enforce the format. Neither consults the edition, and both are correct for 85. The 85-only arms (identifier-operand placement, empty '( )') are separate ConstructRegistry gates, and both fire as they should. Citations use §1989 because cite.py files Amendment 1's Section A under the 1989 token (§1985:A.* fails with no-clause).
